findings: All three methods retrieved all 12 predefined target chunks within top 20.
Natural queries achieved the highest macro target MRR in this seven-topic evaluation.
Manual rewriting improved target ranking for glass, metal, and batteries, but reduced it for electronics.
Automatic rewriting did not improve aggregate ranking over natural queries in this evaluation.
Retrieval latency excludes the time and cost of generating automatic rewrites.
limitations: Evaluation covers only seven topics and the current v4_expanded index.
Target-chunk MRR depends on the predefined target set.
Results do not establish that the same ranking will hold for all user queries.
next_step: Keep natural queries as the default. In a later experiment, test a selective fallback for queries whose initial retrieval has weak evidence.
